title: Eulogy For TikTok
subtitle: A meditation in the least commercial medium humanly possible
body_html:
Poetry is the antithesis of video content. Video content online is a huge money maker. Poetry is not commercial. Today, in memory of TikTok, I have an authored a poem to commemorate the moment. It’s possible TikTok will be Jesus-like, resurrected, if not by God, then by The D*nald. Capitol Hill is our Golgotha. Will a new religion spring forth?

I was going to do a Shakespeare parody, but instead, this came out. A commercial hit, It will not be. I have a whole book of poetry; you can purchase it here (amazon affiliate link). Or another here. Or my Inessential Pharmacology book of prose about drugs. Absent TikTok, I’m left plugging products in a words-only sales funnel like a CHUMP. This will…never do.

For You

It understood me,

Be I venal or virtuous

Whether my hunger was for tradwife wisdom or the vicissitudes of BamaRush

It Got Ready With Me.

You got ready with me, too.

I felt understood.

While I was presented with humorous anecdotes—

Parodies of politics or

Offers to explain other trends—

That I, clearly, did not comprehend.

I was less alone than I had ever been,

And very lonely in the process.

For You made sure to never be For Thou.

Heaving waves of the North Sea were for me.

Invitations to Hawk Tuah!

15 minutes of fame would never do,

15 seconds approached, asymptotically, was about all we could do.

We casually substituted words like they didn't matter,

Corn, forlorn.

Mindful of our minders.

Did you know there was such a thing as a viral drinks fridges?

I did not.

And now I'm infected and can't sate my thirst.

For You, alas, is no more.

I'm left with words, naked, absent a quick edit, each word not carefully selected for me.

None of these things, not one of these words, not a single one, has been selected because it will be pleasing to me, specifically.

I am left wanting, wonton, unsatisfied,

Unanticipated.

Nobody knows what's next; none of this world is For Me.

For You was a gift from other

Minds crafting an algorithm to feed me

Only what I was hungry for, until I, oe’r full, vomited out my own videos

To feed others on my regurgitations, with the hope—vain?—that my anger, my absurdity, and my hottest of takes would be For Them, too.

I'm left alone. My mirror doesn't anticipate me. It gives me nothing new next.

Did the swipe break?

I don't know what I want For Me.

We're so lonely, and we want someone to think about us, and For You felt like it did that,

A simulacrum of interest

And engagement,

Now, my thirst is rendered untrapped.

I've never been thirstier.

Then I am in this moment.

God, give me something to do.

Swipe Left? How about Right?

It’s not working.

Give me something to do.

Give me something!

Maybe it can be curated?

It could be From You.

Share

I’d say you can like and comment, but I expect these are buttons you have been well-trained to “smash.”

Ok, fine. I’ll do a video version. My readers are savvy and probably saw this coming—but it was done, out of respect for our fallen Tok, in a vertical orientation.

Are you happy now, internet?
